questions.title: Beautiful Home Club - Part 1

questions.stem: You are a member of a home living club. You are talking to three other members in the home living chat room. Use 30-40 words.

questions.prompt: You must stay in the bedroom but share with your brother. How do you feel?
questions.sample_answer: I will feel a little uncomfortable because I prefer having a separate bedroom. My brother and I will discuss how we can come up with a solution that suits us both.

questions.prompt: Living in the city or the countryside is better. Do you agree? Why?
questions.sample_answer: Both the city and countryside are ideal places to live, but everyone has their own preferences. I prefer the city because of my work. It offers more conveniences and opportunities, making life easier in many ways.

questions.prompt: Nowadays, old buildings are demolished and replaced with modern buildings. I feel we should protect historic buildings. What do you think about protecting historic buildings?
questions.sample_answer: I agree with protecting historic buildings. We must respect and preserve history. Historic architecture is also unique and interesting, so I believe it should be maintained for future generations to admire.
